meta.title: contentment.org — Launch Plan
meta.summary: Schedule preponed one week per Kristina's updated Gantt: Dave is handing off UI/UX + related tasks early. Design handoff now Jul 27 UIUX–Dev meeting (lands with Sam morning of Jul 28 due to timezone). Dev sprint Jul 27–Aug 7 (Sam-led). Final review Aug 7. Fixes/polish/analytics Aug 10–14 (Nav + WJ approval). Go-live Aug 17–21. Story Board and Reach Map deferred to Phase 2. Per Kristina's Launch Plan sheet comments (27 Jul): About Us + Events confirmed Phase 1 (single page for About, D-05); Stories renamed 'Our Impact'; Homeroom giving page renamed 'Get Involved'; Privacy + Terms pages moved to Phase 2; Homeroom tiers resolved to $25/$50/$100 (D-01); School inquiry form resolved to Google Form + Slack (D-04); /give routing (D-03) pending Lorna's Keela widget confirmation; Anik looped in on cookie consent (D-13) for a second opinion. Further resolved (27 Jul, later thread): D-07 social media URLs are in Dave/Veron's UIUX designs (no separate Comms handoff needed); D-09 EIN/legal copy on /give already included in UIUX; D-10 annual report format → PDF for Phase 1; D-08 legal copy is an action item assigned to Somesh, with Kristina open to a ~Aug 24–28 fast-follow instead of full Phase 2 if prioritized.
